findings.text: Read messages regain highlights after navigation. Node DOM-harness reproduction: open conversation 5 at mark 504, successfully read through 510, finish fading, then open 6 and 5; output unread=0, highlighted=[506,508,510], expected []. Entry clears the remembered state and rebuilds from the stale membership mark. Preserve the confirmed read watermark across navigation and exclude already-read IDs.

The independent fade timer does not follow the actual read. Node reproduction: schedule read+fade, tick 400 ms, reschedule both, tick 100 ms; output posts=0, highlighted=[], fading=[506,508,510]. With a 503 read response, unread remains 3 while those rows still fade. Trigger fading from successful read completion, using the confirmed message boundary, instead of duplicating the debounce with an uncancelled timeout.

Resume detection only runs through openConversation, but Activity → Home uses app.js goPlace(), which directly sets view='chat' and renders. Node reproduction using production goPlace and renderMain: open 5 through 510, switch to notifications, receive others' messages 511/513, call goPlace('home'); output view='chat', highlighted=[], expected [511,513]. Apply resume tracking to every route that restores the conversation.

Messages fetched after returning to a disconnected tab are classified as seen live. Node DOM-harness reproduction: enter through 510, hide and return, call noteTabVisible(), then deliver catch-up messages 511/512 and renderMessages(); highlighted=[], expected [511,512]. The visible render advances seen past the missed messages. Retain the absence watermark through asynchronous reconnect catch-up and classify recovered messages before advancing it.

Highlight state and timers survive account changes; resetUnreadHighlights has no production caller. Node reproduction: schedule A's fade, tick 100 ms, cancel reads, change session generation/resetState, enter the same conversation as B, tick 400 ms; B's highlighted=[506,508,510] becomes [] without B reading. Wire highlight cleanup into account teardown and cancel or generation-guard outstanding fade timers.
